stories.headline: European leaders meet in Dublin as hybrid attacks grow
body: Leaders from over 40 European countries met in Dublin for the European Political Community summit.
Recent hoaxes and cyberattacks on supermarkets, blood banks and airlines topped the agenda.
They also discussed an envoy for Ukraine peace talks.
stories.vc: Security spending is rising across Europe in response.

stories.headline: Truck crash and fire kill 14 in UAE's Fujairah
body: A truck crash involving 23 vehicles killed 14 people and injured 30 in Fujairah.
A driver lost control and hit stationary traffic.
Fire spread to several vehicles.
stories.vc: Major crashes raise pressure for tighter truck safety rules.

stories.headline: Indonesia's vice president resigns over eligibility questions
body: Indonesia's Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has resigned.
Questions were raised over his eligibility and academic credentials.
He is the son of former President Joko Widodo.
stories.vc: Political churn can unsettle investors in Southeast Asia's biggest economy.

stories.headline: Sensex and Nifty edge up for a third day
body: The Sensex rose 32 points to 81,911, and the Nifty gained 44 points to 25,299.
Foreign buying and lower oil helped.
Bajaj Finance and SBI were top gainers.
stories.vc: Steady gains show investors looking past the inflation spike.

stories.headline: Kia plans $2B second plant in Andhra Pradesh
body: Kia and its suppliers will invest about $2 billion in a second plant in Andhra Pradesh.
Production should start in early 2030.
It's expected to create about 12,000 jobs.
stories.joke: More Kias, more jobs, more traffic.
stories.vc: Global carmakers expanding in India boosts the parts supply chain.

stories.headline: Ola Electric's loss narrows but revenue falls 39%
body: Ola Electric's quarterly loss narrowed 13% to ₹362 crore.
But revenue fell 39% to ₹421 crore.
Losses widened 8% from the previous quarter.
stories.vc: Falling sales raise questions about Ola's place in India's EV race.

stories.headline: Moms caring for disabled daughters find hope after midterms
body: Mothers caring for disabled children feared Medicaid cuts before the midterms.
Democrats have pledged to reverse health care cuts after winning Congress.
Caregivers say relief won't come quickly or easily.
stories.vc: Medicaid funding decides how much paid care families can get, and how many mothers can work.
